scope: L8/A23 only; specification, not an evidence receipt
owner: L8 (test); preflight provisioning and certification: L0/DevOps
allowed_execution: one explicit L0-approved functional RED run after independently verified PREFLIGHT_PASS

evidence_contract.receipt_location: outside tracked source and outside public GitHub

checks.requirement: PR HEAD and isolated worktree exact SHA, clean checkout; only L8-owned E2E spec touched
Disposal and isolation: dedicated localhost web+API, no production/pilot endpoints or identity
checks.proof: sanitized service probes, endpoint routing, isolated runtime fingerprint

checks.requirement: Clerk Development pk_test identity with disposable user, organization and active tenant; JWT checked against Dev JWKS
checks.proof: sanitized auth probe and 401/403 cross-tenant negatives

checks.requirement: Dedicated migrated PostgreSQL database named *_test, unique DSN fingerprint, isolated tenant and RLS
checks.proof: migration head, DB scope/tenant probes and cross-tenant denial

checks.requirement: Redis plus Celery worker bound to the same test database/queue/tenant, processing a synthetic test task
checks.proof: queue/worker readiness and persisted synthetic task receipts

checks.requirement: Synthetic provider C2PRO_AI_MOCK=1 AND verified denial of all billable LLM outbound traffic; never test charges
checks.proof: network egress denial and provider invocation/billing baseline counters, no secrets

checks.requirement: Persisted COMPLETE run tied to synthetic contract PDF and literal physical PDF pages, plus budget and schedule XLSX hashes
checks.proof: run/document/source SHA-256, page provenance, distinct document IDs, worker persistence

checks.requirement: Persisted n4-coverage-v1 COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS: three windows, examined ordinal 1 and 3, ordinal 2 OPEN OUTPUT_TRUNCATED, attempts=2, nonblank reason, source SHA pinned
checks.proof: DB-backed coverage/ledger record; examined + gaps = total; no invented successful extraction

checks.requirement: Read-only ledger baseline and replay snapshot; no new paid calls or billable settlements, including after Clerk re-login
checks.proof: before/after counts of reservation, attempt, settlement, billed amount and invocation count

checks.requirement: Both E2E scenarios use correct Clerk test auth initialization and a real persisted backend; no intercepted PASS responses
checks.proof: runner setup probe; health/auth/fixture/source probes; sanitized receipts

checks.requirement: PREFLIGHT_PASS signed by L0/DevOps for exact SHA and fixtures, followed by explicit one-off authorization to L8

run_protocol.if_any_check_missing: STOP; INFRA_BLOCKED; do not run functional Playwright or modify infrastructure
run_protocol.on_all_verified: L8 obtains explicit one-off L0 authorization and independently re-verifies exact SHA/preflight; then executes only L8 E2E
cases: COMPLETE: synthetic contract+budget+schedule -> quotes/pages -> per-finding review -> score -> actual XLSX/PDF -> fresh Clerk login, no regasto
COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS: persisted OPEN gap -> final approval blocked -> validated score null -> persisted review after reload
run_protocol.classification: FUNCTIONAL_RED only after true PREFLIGHT_PASS and genuine failing product assertion; failures of Clerk, worker, fixture, flags or dependencies remain INFRA_BLOCKED
deliverables: exact SHA, CI/check status, risk verdict posted in PR #1294 and #1285
prohibitions: no GREEN until all integration dependencies and L0 decision
